headline: Inflation climbs to highest level in nearly 2 years
summary: The federal cost-of-living report showed inflation at its highest level in nearly two years, with a spike in gasoline prices from the war with Iran a contributor.
why: Inflation data drives Federal Reserve policy expectations, which move Treasury yields, equities and the dollar.

source.name: WGCU News | PBS & NPR for Southwest Florida

sources.name: WGCU News | PBS & NPR for Southwest Florida

why_moved: Inflation reaching a near two-year high, driven by energy prices, raises the prospect of tighter monetary policy.
